cd /app && python3 -c "
import re
bad=0
with open('input.csv') as f:
    for i,l in enumerate(f,1):
        s=l.rstrip('\n')
        parts=[p.strip().upper() for p in s.split(',')]
        if len(parts)!=3: bad+=1; print('LEN',i,repr(s)); break
        exp=';'.join(parts[::-1])+';OK'
        with open('expected.csv') as g:
            pass
# verify full
with open('input.csv') as f, open('expected.csv') as g:
    for i,(l1,l2) in enumerate(zip(f,g),1):
        s=l1.rstrip('\n')
        parts=[p.strip().upper() for p in s.split(',')]
        exp=';'.join(parts[::-1])+';OK\n'
        if exp!=l2:
            print('MISMATCH',i,repr(s),repr(l2)); break
    else:
        print('ALL MATCH, pattern confirmed')
"
